texts.li: [winter] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} came in out of the snow with a limp from an old wound and a pack that clanks at every step. This was {X_possessive} last winter on the road, {X_nameDef} says.\n\nThe pack and everything in it can stay here for {COUNT} silver. So could {X_nameDef}, by how close {X_pronoun} sits to the fire.

[industrial] Convoy guard, eleven years, across the wastes. {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} says it the way other people give their name, then asks if the colony is buying.\n\nThe kit in the pack goes for {COUNT} silver. The vest with three patched holes in it stays on {X_nameDef}.

[past:soldier] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} asked {A_nameDef} where {A_pronoun} had served before either of them said hello. The two old soldiers have been trading the names of battles ever since.\n\n{X_nameDef} is done with all that, and the kit is for sale for {COUNT} silver. {A_nameDef} has already looked it over twice.

[summer] Long days are mapmaking days, says {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, who has been out on the colony's hills since sunrise without asking anyone. {X_nameDef} would survey them properly for {COUNT} silver, or roughly and for nothing with {A_nameDef} as a guide.

[skill:Mining] {A_nameDef} has been asking {X_nameDef}, a surveyor of {FACTION}, about the rock under the colony since breakfast, and getting good answers. A proper survey costs {COUNT} silver. With {A_nameDef} along as a guide, {X_nameDef} would do a rough one for free.

[troubled,winter] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} asked by gestures to sit near the colony for a day or two, then sat down in the snow to wait for the answer. {A_nameDef}, who has been struggling lately, took {X_objective} a blanket and stayed out there a while.

[industrial] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} hands over a printed card at the gate: a vow of silence, three years kept, and a request for a place to sit near people for a day or two.\n\n{A_nameDef} read it and has gone back to read it again.

[leg,lowtech] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} carves peg legs from seasoned ash and fits them with leather straps, and noticed {A_nameDef} on {A_possessive} crutch across the yard. Before leaving, {X_nameDef} would like to fit {A_objective} with a {TALE}.\n\n{X_nameDef} wants {COUNT} silver for it, or {PLACE}, which would go into the next one.

[leg,!lowtech] {X_nameDef}, a limb-maker of {FACTION}, unfolds a workbench from the side of {X_possessive} cart and opens a box of knee joints, sorted by size. {X_nameDef} could have {A_nameDef} walking on a {TALE} by tonight.\n\n{COUNT} silver, or {PLACE}.

[arm] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} lost an arm once and makes them now. {X_nameDef} rolled up a sleeve to show {A_nameDef} {X_possessive} own, then offered to fit {A_objective} with a {TALE}.\n\nIt would cost {COUNT} silver, or {PLACE} in materials.

[jaw] {X_nameDef}, who makes false teeth and jaws for {FACTION}, noticed {A_nameDef} soaking {A_possessive} bread at supper and has offered to fit {A_objective} with a {TALE}. {X_nameDef} asks {COUNT} silver, or {PLACE} in materials.

[foot] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} has fitted feet to half the farmers in {FACTION}'s valleys and, once, to a very old horse. {X_nameDef} has offered {A_nameDef} a {TALE}, measured and fitted before dark.\n\nThe price is {COUNT} silver, or {PLACE} in materials.
[winter] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} makes limbs, and is waiting out the cold here. Rather than sit idle, {X_nameDef} offers to fit {A_nameDef} with a {TALE} for {COUNT} silver, or {PLACE} in materials.

[winter] {X_nameDef}, a merchant of {FACTION}, wants backers for a winter run while prices are high. Twice the stake back in about ten days, {X_nameDef} says, if the passes stay open.\n\n{A_nameDef} has noticed the "if."

[colony:Restless] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} has heard that this colony likes a gamble, and has brought one: a caravan venture, twice the stake back in about ten days. {A_nameDef} has been handed the plan to look over, and is looking very hard.
[colony:Merciful] {FACTION} know the colony's name for mercy, and offer {COUNT} silver for {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} all the same. Mercy, their rider says, is for people whose barns are still standing.

[colony:Harsh] {FACTION} have heard how this colony deals with its enemies, and expect it to understand them. They want {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} out of the cells and in their hands, and will pay {COUNT} silver for it.

[summer] Out of water and bleeding into the dust, {X_nameDef} still had a hand on {X_possessive} weapon when {A_nameDef} found {X_objective} in the shade of a rock past the fields. {X_nameDef}'s lips are cracked, and {X_pronoun} won't say who did it.\n\nWhoever it was could follow the blood here as easily as {A_nameDef} did.

[trait:Kind] {A_nameDef} tore a strip off {A_possessive} own shirt to bind {X_nameDef}'s wound before running back to ask the council what to do. {X_nameDef}, found hurt past the fields, won't say who did it, and won't let go of {X_possessive} weapon either.

[spring] Mud to the knees of {X_possessive} horse, {X_nameDef}, reeve to a lord of {FACTION}, came up the spring road to say that the colony's fields belong to the lord and owe a tithe: {COUNT} silver, or {TALE} in kind, carried to {PLACE}.\n\n{A_nameDef} has already asked to see the map.

[past:noble] {X_nameDef}, reeve to a lord of {FACTION}, has come to collect a tithe of {COUNT} silver, or {TALE} in kind. {A_nameDef}, who grew up on the other side of a reeve's ledger, knows how these claims are made, and how they're unmade.

[winter] {X_nameDef}, an envoy of {ENEMY}, has walked through the snow under a white cloth to make an offer: {COUNT} silver, or {TALE}, and the feud is over. {ENEMY} have had a hard winter too, {X_nameDef} says.

[industrial] A {FACTION} drone with a cracked wing came down {PLACE}, and has been ticking to itself ever since like a cooling stove. {A_nameDef} thinks its memory could be read. It could also be stripped for parts, or sent back to {FACTION} for a reward.

[industrial] The radio has been picking up a voice on an old band since last night, the same short message in a language {A_nameDef} half recognizes, ending each time on what might be a name. It seems to be coming from somewhere close.\n\nAnswering would give the colony's position away. {A_nameDef} could also try to trace it without answering.
[gifted] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} set a book on the table, {THING}, and {A_nameDef} felt it before {A_pronoun} saw it. {X_nameDef} watched {A_nameDef}'s face and named a price: {COUNT} silver.
